posts.author: EbonSkolli
posts.body:
I just made another MZ plugin. This one applies shop discounts/inflation based on the party leader's Luck stat.
HOW TO USE:
In the plugin parameters, enter a baseline number for the Luck stat. Anything above the number you enter here will trigger discounts while stats lower than this number will cause prices to go up.
Next, set the percent values for the price changes. By default, it is set to 1%.
Additionally, you can setup minimum and maximum buy rates. The same can also be done for sell rates.
TERMS OF USE:
Use for commercial or non-commercial projects. Please credit EbonSkolli if you use this plugin.
